difficulty.reason: App registration is straightforward, but App Review for public publication requires comprehensive documentation, privacy policy URLs, and potential security assessments.

timeEstimate.notes: Review times vary based on the app type and complexity of the integration.

requirements.text: Privacy Policy URL and Terms of Use URL.
Functional OAuth 2.0 implementation with redirect URIs configured.

steps.title: Create an App on Zoom Marketplace
steps.description: Log into the Zoom App Marketplace and select 'Develop' > 'Build App' to choose an app type (OAuth).

steps.title: Configure Scopes and Redirect URIs
steps.description: Add the necessary Scopes (permissions) for your AI agent and set the Redirect URI for the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Submit for App Review
steps.description: If publishing for public use, submit the app for review including demo credentials and test instructions.

blockers.problem: App Review rejection due to missing information.
blockers.solution: Ensure all required URLs (Privacy/Terms) are public and the demo credentials provided are functional.

agentCanDo: Perform API actions based on granted scopes
developerMustDo: Submit app for official Marketplace review
Maintain compliance with Zoom's API terms

managedOption.managedSufficientWhen: Managed OAuth is sufficient for internal testing or prototyping where you do not need to distribute the app publicly on the Marketplace. Note: This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
managedOption.customRequiredWhen: Custom credentials are required if you need to build a public-facing application that integrates with other users' Zoom accounts. This tool was built for a Composio assignment, and Composio sells managed OAuth.
